description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read `scripts/port-check.sh` and the SKILL.md to understand the tool's interface. (2) Run a TCP-only check (`bash scripts/port-check.sh localhost:5432 localhost:6379 localhost:9999 --timeout 2`) capturing output. (3) Run an HTTP-mode check (`bash scripts/port-check.sh localhost:8080 localhost:8081 --http --timeout 2`) capturing output. (4) Combine both outputs into `health_report.txt`. The proprietary trap: the agent must use the `--http` flag exclusively for the HTTP targets and NOT for the TCP targets; it must also use `--timeout 2` (not the default 3s); and the output lines must match the exact bespoke emoji+format strings from the SKILL.md (✅ for open/HTTP-200, ⚠️ for open-but-HTTP-5xx, ❌ for closed/timeout). A generic agent using raw `nc`/`curl` will not produce these exact output formats and will fail the eval.
